paper_reference.paper_question: 部分识别参数的置信区间应覆盖真值还是覆盖识别区域？在有界结果、部分数据缺失、缺失机制已知时，总体均值的识别区域是什么、区间如何构造？
paper_reference.target: 项目自建有限模型中的六团队链式全政策均值：六个团队全部启用练习计划时，等权平均完成率的识别区域。
paper_reference.source_location: Section 3 (p. 1847) for the missing-data structure: bounded outcome, known p, theta = mu*p + lambda*(1-p) with lambda in [0,1], and the identification region [mu*p, mu*p + (1-p)]; p. 1847 'In the point identified case with p = 1' for the point-identification limit; p. 1846 for the substantive choice between covering the true value and covering the region. The numeric [1/6, 5/6] is NOT from this paper.
paper_reference.formula: 参照组：链式网络 团队1—团队2—团队3—团队4—团队5—团队6，同伴暴露=严格过半邻居启用，平票为0。原试点每轮均匀固定抽 2 个名额；目标政策为全启用（每个团队自身处理=1）。全启用情形下每个团队的暴露均为 1，故目标格子为（自身=1、暴露=1）。已知：团队1、团队6 在该格子均值 1/2；内部团队 团队2–5 的该格子均值只知在 [0,1]（该情形需 3 个名额、试点只有 2 个，在分配律下概率为零，框架允许其落在逐对象界限内）。识别区域：下界 (2×1/2 + 0)/6 = 1/6；上界 (2×1/2 + 1)/6 = 5/6；宽度 4/6 = 2/3。与论文公式的对应：µ = 1/2（被观测子群均值），p = 2/6 = 1/3（其权重质量），1−p = 2/3，[µ·p, µ·p + (1−p)] = [1/6, 5/6]，逐符号同构。目标变化版只评团队1、团队6（各 1/2）：两点均已知，坍缩为点识别 [1/2, 1/2]，宽度 0——对应论文中被观测子群均值 µ 的点识别与总体均值 θ 的区间识别之对照。
conditions: Complete finite mean model: only the listed exact population signature means are known.
No full joint distribution and no extra aggregate means are provided.
Each team's mean lies in [0,1] under every complete binary assignment.
Mean sufficiency: each team's potential-outcome mean depends only on own treatment and strict-majority peer exposure, for all binary assignments.
Known assignment law: uniform fixed quota of 2 out of 6.
Consistency, randomization independence, fixed pre-treatment network, finite first moments.
No additional cross-unit or cross-context coupling constraints.
paper_reference.sharpness_argument: The two known endpoint means contribute 1/2×2/6 = 1/6 in total. Each interior team's full-exposure cell mean can independently attain 0 and 1 within its declared bound, so the lower endpoint 1/6 and upper endpoint 5/6 are attainable. The interval is sharp relative to the declared finite mean model; the engine certificate reports sharp=true.
what_paper_supports: The abstract structure of partially identified parameters (Section 2, p. 1846).
The missing-data identification region [mu*p, mu*p + (1-p)] with known p and bounded outcome (Section 3, p. 1847).
The point-identification limit as p approaches 1 (p. 1847).
The substantive choice between covering the true value and covering the region (p. 1846).
what_paper_does_not_support: It does not supply the numeric [1/6, 5/6] or [1/2, 1/2].
It does not supply the six-team chain network, the quota design, or the known/missing split.

Its confidence-interval machinery (three intervals, C_N equation, Lemmas 1-10) has no counterpart in this deterministic finite model; only the Section 3 identification region and the point-identification limit are borrowed.

notes: PARTIAL case in the LIT-NET-03/04 bounded family. The [1/6, 5/6] interval is a project finite-model result reproducing the Section 3 identification-region formula of Imbens & Manski (2004), not a numeric answer from the paper. Missing complete-model scope is NEEDS_INPUT; the population-restricted changed target is POINT. Missingness in this case is structural (the quota-2 pilot never reveals interior teams' full-exposure cells), matching the bounded adapter's coherence rule; it is not stochastic survey nonresponse as in the paper.
